9. The Transporter / Driver shall report to SSC(NR) representative at the sp ecified time of the day or wherever asked to report. 15.The Transporter shall provide Telephone No. /Mobile No. and his complet e official and residential address to SSC, NR for correspondence. 16. Provisioning of white colour uniform to the driver will be the contractor's responsibility. 26.
